# Welcome {.unnumbered}

**Anyone Can Linux** starts with an old computer you were about to throw away and ends with you understanding the operating system that runs most of the world's servers, phones and gadgets.

Along the way you'll install Linux, learn the terminal, fix things when they break, and even play your games on it. No prior experience needed.

::: {.callout-important}
## Early draft
This book is being written in the open, and most chapters are still outlines. Follow along, or jump in and help.
:::

## How this book works

Each chapter pulls back one layer of the system. Commands in the book are tested automatically, and each chapter lists when it was last checked.

::: {.callout-note}
## Concept box
Connects what you're learning to devices and software you already use.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Break it on purpose
A safe way to break something and fix it. You'll learn more from one recovery than from ten tutorials.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Level up
A checkpoint listing what you can now explain to someone else.
:::
